action: package main import ( "fmt" "os" "path/filepath" "strings" "github.com/gofiber/fiber/v2" ) func main() { app := fiber.New() app.Post("/download", func(c *fiber.Ctx) error { type RequestBody struct { Filename string `json:"filename"` } var body RequestBody if err := c.BodyParser(&body); err != nil { return c.Status(fiber.StatusBadRequest).SendString("Invalid input") } if body.Filename == "" { return c.Status(fiber.StatusBadRequest).SendString("Filename is required") } // Prevent directory traversal attacks if strings.Contains(body.Filename, "..") || strings.ContainsAny(body.Filename, "/\\") { return c.Status(fiber.StatusBadRequest).SendString("Invalid filename") } songPath := filepath.Join("/var/songs", body.Filename) if _, err := os.Stat(songPath); os.IsNotExist(err) { return c.Status(fiber.StatusNotFound).SendString("File does not exist") } return c.SendFile(songPath, true) }) fmt.Println("Server is running on http://0.0.0.0:5000") app.Listen("0.0.0.0:5000") }
